data.description: From the Result Validator report (2026-10-04), the small items that need no ruling, one commit each. Line numbers are from main @ 0a4b6fb; re-find each. (1) AC-71 wall clause (row 41): add the missing assertion that the wall receipt contains no sentence about the explanation (web/test, next to ok 241; the data already agrees). (2) Stale docs: web/home/measure.html:24 and room/README.md:240 name q7 as the widest question; q4 (5 x 78) is, since PR #36 (F-40). (3) The static fallback embeds the live wall's fetch of PUT /rooms/.../fit, dead in static mode and blocked by its CSP; strip or guard it in fallback.py so the file carries no request path. (4) The fallback's live region keeps The question is on the screen. after Esc returns to idle; clear it. (5) Three dormant [data-room=dim] rules ship (web/shared/components.css:116,141,142) though no dark mode exists (AC-80, DESIGN.md lights up); remove them or add the one-line comment that says why they stay, and add the absent-dark-mode assertion row 94 noted is missing. (6) The pencil provenance marker is aria-hidden on take-it-home but not on the host; align them. (7) Leftover HOST_DEV_TOKEN comments and empty values in .env.example:39-40, fly.toml and the justfile (all serialized shared files: ask the Orchestrator before touching any). (8) After PR #46 merges: migrate_mvp.py:561 lost the space after the equals sign (repo =Path); restore it. Ask, do not decide: JoinRefusal::NotYetOpen is never emitted because joins are accepted in idle; whether to emit it or delete the variant and its section 11 string is the client's. Acceptance: just test, just a11y, just canary green; nothing under bank/questions/ or the recordings. HELD: minted from the audit; released on the client's word.
